media_lib.base_desc: Master switch, Emby / OpenSubsonic endpoints and app keys
media_lib.protocol_disabled: Not enabled (turn on {{key}} in the settings above)
media_lib.protocol_auth_tip: If the Emby/Subsonic client has no key field, use your OpenList username and put the app key in the password field. For Subsonic clients that append /rest automatically, set the address to /@rest.
media_lib.app_keys_desc: Used for Subsonic token auth, Emby api_key and headless clients such as MoviePilot. If a client has no key field, enter your OpenList username and put the key in the password field
media_lib.key_once: This key is shown only once, copy it now:
media_lib.scrape_desc: Metadata sources, thumbnail storage and scrape concurrency
media_lib.strm_desc: Generate .strm files during scan, or run a bulk generation here
media_lib.strm_output_same_dir: Next to the media files (same name, .strm extension)
media_lib.strm_output_missing: Not configured (save the STRM directory above first)
media_lib.thumb_scope: Applies to {{type}} only; falls back to the global media settings when unset.
media_lib.thumb_store_tips: Generate thumbnails while scraping; when off, the original image path is used as the cover
media_lib.mode_base64_tips: Thumbnails are stored in the database as Base64. No extra file storage is needed, but the database grows.
media_lib.mode_runtime_tips: Thumbnails are stored under the program data directory, data/imgs by default. No mounted storage is required.
media_lib.mode_local_tips: Thumbnails are written to a VFS path under a mounted storage, which must be writable (e.g. /imgs).
media_lib.thumb_path_tips_runtime: Path relative to the program data directory, imgs by default (data/imgs)
media_lib.thumb_path_tips_local: VFS path relative to the mount root /, e.g. /imgs or /.thumbnail
media_lib.thumb_rerun: Changes take effect after re-scraping (clear scraped data in Media Manage, then run scraping again).
media_lib.thumb_config_missing: Media type config not loaded, please refresh and try again
media_lib.thumb_saved: Thumbnail settings saved, effective after re-scraping
media_lib.prefetch_idle: Off. Turn on subtitle_prefetch_library above to extract the missing embedded subtitles of every library video in the background.
media_lib.prefetch_enabled_idle: On, waiting for the next pass.
media_lib.prefetch_progress: {{files}} / {{total}} files looked at, {{tracks}} subtitle tracks extracted
